mostWorthwhile.text: Building the tendon tissue was most worthwhile because it connected collagen fibres to the link between muscle and cartilage, and contrasted them with proteins inside muscle cells.

leastWorthwhile.text: The two paths became a little repetitive: both involved a message, RNA instructions and amino acids. The repetition did help show the comparison, though.

surprise.text: I was surprised that cells with the same DNA could develop such different structures: pulling proteins inside muscle cells and collagen fibres outside tendon cells.

arbitrary.text: The named messenger pairings depended on the goals and pictures; I could follow them without understanding exactly how the messages changed the cells.

continue.text: I would choose to continue, because comparing where the proteins ended up helped me understand how different cell jobs fit together, and I would be curious to see how the muscle cells are assembled later.
